acrs: v1.0 had the board wrapper synchronise estop/arm/bench AND safety synchronise estop/arm again (double sync, wrong for the ASIC where there is no wrapper). Now: raw pins enter the SoC; safety_fault_monitor synchronises estop_n_i and arm_sw_i; actuation_subsystem synchronises bench_en_i and bench_sel_i (2-FF each); i2c already synchronises scl_i/sda_i; clk_rst_gen handles rst_n_in and pll_locked_i. ecu_fpga_top does NO synchronisation.
internal to safety and actuation; no port change; removes logic from the FPGA-only wrapper
The SENS STATUS bit DATA_FRESH ("a sample arrived in the last 2 ticks") needs a time base, but sensor_pipeline had no tick input. Add control_tick_i from timer_unit.
one new input port on sensor_pipeline; one more load on net control_tick
v1.0 said "reset 0" and "TILT_EN reset 1". Now: reset = 0x04 | (DEF_WD_EN<<1) | DEF_EN, i.e. TILT_EN=1, ARM=DEF_EN.

duty_l_o, duty_r_o (actuation), core_sleep_o, double_fault_seen_o (cpu) and dbg_o are debug/bring-up taps: they drive named nets with no functional load. FPGA: ILA probes / LEDs. ASIC: left unconnected (dbg_o may become spare pins).
Reset-assertion rule for testbenches and Ibex

Ibex flops reset on the FALLING EDGE of rst_ni (asynchronous). Every testbench must start rst_n high and pull it low after time 0. Our blocks keep synchronous resets; only clk_rst_gen uses async assert.

The sheet did not say what imu_init_done_o does when the sequencer re-runs init after 3 consecutive errors. Now: it goes low when init starts and high when init completes. Arming needs calib_done_i, which is reachable only after init; imu_init_done_i is also shown on dbg_o[2].
behaviour clarification inside i2c_sensor_subsystem; no port change
Ibex port list updated to the pinned commit af456e2
The v1.0 sheet listed an older Ibex port set. cpu_subsystem (starter kit, lint-clean) now ties every port; its external interface is unchanged.
